description: Complete rewrite of ChatEngine.lua combining v1.0 scrollable BeginChild structure with v2.0 auto-hide state machine, text shadow, brighter colors, accent bar, and category prefix colors. Discord dark theme background with configurable settings.
steps: Rewrite ChatEngine.lua at /projects/sandbox/samp-android-lua-script/ChatEngine.lua with the complete implementation described below.

HEADER SECTION: script_name('ChatEngine'), script_author('OnlyDexterZ'). Load libraries: require 'mimgui' as imgui, require 'inicfg', pcall require 'samp.events', pcall require 'lib.chatengine_lib'. Set DPI_SCALE = MONET_DPI_SCALE or 1.0.

CONFIG SECTION: Use inicfg with defaultConfig containing Settings table: enabled(true), fontSize(14), autoHideDelay(10), showTimestamp(true), showAccentBar(true). Load/save via inicfg.load and inicfg.save with filename 'ChatEngine.ini'.

STATE MACHINE: Define states STATE_HIDDEN=0, STATE_FADE_IN=1, STATE_VISIBLE=2, STATE_FADE_OUT=3. FADE_IN_DURATION=0.5, FADE_OUT_DURATION=2.0. Track chatState, stateStartTime (os.clock()), lastInsertionCount. Functions: getMasterAlpha() calculates alpha based on state/elapsed time, updateStateMachine() handles transitions (visible -> fade_out after autoHideDelay seconds, fade_out -> hidden after 2s), onNewMessage() resets/cancels fade (hidden->fade_in, fade_out->visible, visible resets timer), checkNewMessages() polls chatlib.getInsertionCount().

CATEGORY COLORS TABLE: PM={0.2,0.9,0.4} (green), OOC={0.6,0.6,0.6} (grey), IC={0.9,0.9,1.0} (white), Ad={1.0,0.85,0.2} (yellow), Action={0.8,0.4,0.9} (purple), Server={0.3,0.3,0.3}. Prefixes: PM='[PM] ', OOC='[OOC] ', IC='[IC] ', Ad='[AD] ', Action='[ACT] '.

SHADOW TEXT HELPER: Function renderTextWithShadow(drawList, screenX, screenY, text, r, g, b, alpha) that calls drawList:AddText with black color (0,0,0, alpha*0.8) at offset (screenX + 1*DPI_SCALE, screenY + 1*DPI_SCALE).

MAIN CHAT WINDOW (imgui.OnFrame): Condition function calls checkNewMessages() and updateStateMachine() every frame, returns true always. Render function: (a) self.HideCursor=true, (b) if not chatInterceptEnabled return, (c) get masterAlpha, if <=0.01 return, (d) Position: 10*DPI_SCALE, 10*DPI_SCALE. Size: 45% screen width, 35% screen height. (e) Push styles: WindowBg=Discord dark (0.08,0.09,0.14, 0.5*masterAlpha), ChildBg=(0.06,0.07,0.11, 0.4*masterAlpha), Border=(0,0,0,0), WindowRounding=8*DPI_SCALE, WindowPadding=8*DPI_SCALE, ItemSpacing=2*DPI_SCALE. (f) SetNextWindowPos/Size, Begin with NoTitleBar+NoResize+NoMove+NoScrollbar+NoInputs flags. (g) SetWindowFontScale(fontSize/14.0). (h) Header: TextColored 'Chat Engine' in accent blue (0.4,0.7,1.0,masterAlpha), then Separator. (i) BeginChild('##ChatScroll', ImVec2(0,-1), false, 0) for scrollable message area.

MESSAGE RENDERING inside BeginChild: Get messages from chatlib.getMessages(). For each message: (a) Calculate gradient alpha = masterAlpha * max(0.5, idx/#messages) so older=0.5 floor, newer=full. (b) Get cursor/window positions for DrawList operations. (c) If showAccentBar and msg.category exists and not 'Server': draw 3px wide colored bar on left via DrawList:AddRectFilled using categoryColors. (d) Offset text by 6*DPI_SCALE if accent bar shown. (e) If showTimestamp: render timestamp with shadow+TextColored in dim color (0.5,0.5,0.6, gradientAlpha*0.7), SameLine. (f) If category prefix exists (not Server): render prefix with shadow+TextColored in category color, SameLine. (g) Render message segments from msg.parsed_segments: for each segment, brighten colors by 20% (min(1.0, seg.r*1.2)), render shadow via renderTextWithShadow then TextColored, use SameLine(0,0) between segments.
AUTO-SCROLL: After rendering all messages, detect new messages via insertion count change. If new message arrived, call imgui.SetScrollHereY(1.0) to scroll to bottom. Then EndChild().

CONFIG PANEL (second imgui.OnFrame): Condition: showConfigWindow[0]. Dark themed window (centered, 380x400 DPI_SCALE). Title 'ChatEngine Config'. Toggle buttons (NOT Checkbox) for: [ON/OFF] ChatEngine, [ON/OFF] Timestamps, [ON/OFF] Accent Bar. SliderFloat for fontSize (10-24, '%.0f'), SliderFloat for autoHideDelay (3-30, '%.0f'). Save button calls saveConfig() which persists to inicfg. Use PushStyleVarFloat, PushStyleVarVec2, PushStyleColor (matching existing pattern). Pop all styles at end.

SAMP.EVENTS HOOKS: sampev.onServerMessage(color, text) - if chatInterceptEnabled and chatlib: chatlib.addMessage(text, color), return false. sampev.onChatMessage(playerId, text) - if chatInterceptEnabled and chatlib: format as 'playerName (id): text' (pcall for sampGetPlayerNickname), chatlib.addMessage(formatted, 0xFFFFFFFF, 'IC'), return false.

MAIN FUNCTION: Wait isSampAvailable. Register /chatcfg command (toggle config panel). Register /ceoff command (toggle interception on/off with sampAddChatMessage feedback). Add startup message to chatlib buffer (not sampAddChatMessage). Clear default chat: wait(1000) then 15x sampAddChatMessage('', -1). Wait for sampIsLocalPlayerSpawned, wait(1000), 15x clear again. Keep alive with while true do wait(100) end.

TECHNICAL CONSTRAINTS TO FOLLOW: (1) require 'mimgui' not 'imgui', (2) PushStyleVarFloat/PushStyleVarVec2 not generic PushStyleVar, (3) Button toggles not Checkbox, (4) NO pcall around imgui calls, (5) Handle MONET_DPI_SCALE, (6) Library loaded as require('lib.chatengine_lib'), (7) DO NOT modify lib/chatengine_lib.lua.
